items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Issue 932: security finalize now resolves the compliance plugin in repo and plugin cache (newest installed version); same class fixed in shipwright-run constants and the two shipwright-grade bridges.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Resolver failures fall back to the legacy repo-layout path, so the existing 'missing: <path>' error still fires; missing sibling returns None.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Path resolution only; loads a sibling file shipped in the same plugin install tree; no network, no user input.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Fake cache trees built in tmp_path exercise the real code from a cache-shaped location; repo layout still pinned.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New files for new tests; shared resolver stdlib-only and loaded by path per ADR-045.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Plugin install layout (<cache>/shipwright/<plugin>/<version>/, shared/ beside plugins) verified against the real local cache listing.
